name: VCP Interpolation Scheme
definition: An interpolation scheme to obtain VCP vectors at arbitrary locations within a grid cell by combining a plane-based projection method with trilinear interpolation to avoid artifacts.
summary: The VCP Interpolation Scheme estimates Vector-to-Closest-Point vectors by combining trilinear interpolation and plane-based projection, selecting the result with the greater magnitude to eliminate artifacts from opposing vectors or smoothed boundaries.
